nodes.name: alert.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Alert container component (shadcn-svelte) that defines tailwind-variants styling with default and destructive variants and renders a role=alert wrapper with slotted children.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte 5 runes ($props, $bindable) with a `module` script exporting `alertVariants` (tailwind-variants) and the `AlertVariant` type.

nodes.name: alert-action.svelte
nodes.summary: Absolutely-positioned action slot for the Alert component, rendering children in the top-right corner.

nodes.name: alert-description.svelte
nodes.summary: Muted description body sub-component for the Alert, styling text and nested links/paragraphs.

nodes.name: alert-title.svelte
nodes.summary: Heading title sub-component for the Alert that renders emphasized text and adapts layout when an icon is present.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Alert UI component set, re-exporting the Root/Description/Title/Action parts under both short and prefixed aliases plus the alertVariants helper.
